searchText: i used to give the lions a heads up on shut, then they tried to fuck me on he calvin considering retirement story. write something late on a tuesday night i heard from a couple players, reached out to him, lions. on wednesday morning keenist the rat said he'd get me something from calvin - didn't have calvin's number at the time, just email - told me to wait, wait. finally told kevin to push the button, probably 1:30 or so. 20 minutes later they send out a comment to everyone. i was livid. freep dave birkett
